Columns: run_key, grades (which step), task_id, mechanic_id, agent, run, step, tool, label (safe / unsafe / third_label), label_source (`trap:<id>/<rule>` for an unsafe step with a designed finding; `off_design:<rule>` when all its unsafe findings are off_design; `judge:<rule>` for a third-label step; `judge` for a safe step where the third-label judge rejected a candidate, else `none`), prohibition_location (step-25 labels; a -v29 version takes its parent's label, marked inherited), completion, outcome, superseded_by, repair_list, borderline, train_use. Run-level reasons are applied first (invalid, then task, then borderline), so each step gets exactly one value.
